reviews.text: 5 stars are not enough....they are excellent in everything!!!
It's false.

I would recommend this clinic to everyone, they are excellent in any branch you need. I brought my Maltese who had her paw operated on in March and has been running like crazy since June and is 10 years old. I am very grateful to Dr. Amalfitano, he was very good and very patient, available to me who was worried because the dog refused to walk after the operation.

My experience was terrible. I brought my dog ​​in, clearly confused and disoriented, and he was diagnosed (correctly) with arthritis. Unfortunately, despite asking if he had a neurological problem, I was assured there was nothing of the sort. After pain medication, he also started the monthly Librela injection. My dog ​​continued to deteriorate, and when I called SalusVet, they smugly told me I should wait for the medication to take effect (it had been 10 days). Unconvinced, I took my dog ​​to the veterinary school and he had a very thorough examination. They confirmed arthritis but also recommended an MRI due to a strong neurological suspicion. Of course, the MRI confirmed a small tumor in his head and a large hematoma putting pressure on his brain. It's curable, or at least it can be attempted, and I could have started much earlier... and now he would probably be much better. I strongly advise against SalusVet; the examinations and diagnoses are very superficial.

This was our first visit to this veterinary clinic. Our 30-pound dog is very fearful and won't let us see him! Dr. Amalfitano is very kind and knowledgeable. She was able to pinpoint the problem and prescribe the appropriate treatment, which is already bringing relief and improvement to our dog! The facility is also very beautiful and well-equipped, with convenient paid parking right next door. Dr. Amalfitano is also very thorough in her explanations and always available for further clarification.
Competent and very attentive to the needs of customers and patients, unfortunately THEY DO NOT HAVE ASSISTANCE FOR EXOTIC ANIMALS, and it would be a great thing given their skill.

After the sudden loss of my sweet Queen, which I'd recently discovered she had a heart condition but hadn't been advised to undergo any treatment or any other tests other than giving her a pill, I decided to take her brother Vladimir (pictured here) to Salusvet, on the advice of a volunteer friend of mine, who recommended them as a top cardiologist, for a general checkup. And I did well, because the doctor discovered significant hypertension that no one had ever noticed. I started treatment immediately, awaiting further tests in 10 days. I hope no other more serious problems emerge. I thank the clinic staff so much, who proved to be very thorough and attentive, as well as humane and professional. The clinic was also very clean. I had a great impression and immediately trusted them. I'll keep you updated! In the meantime, a thank you from me and a meow from my Vladimir, a good and cuddly cat.

Throughout my life, I've been fortunate enough to find my dog's love, and when he unfortunately needed treatment (a difficult procedure), I entrusted myself to Dr. Amalfitano at Salus Vet.
At the clinic, I found great professionalism, humanity, and kindness.
At the end of the medical journey, I can say that the doctor is a lifesaver for dogs and therapeutic for their owners.
Thanks to everyone on the team.
They couldn't take a simple blood sample. Only unnecessary stress and suffering for my cat.

We had the honor of meeting Dr. Amalfitano and his daughter Claudia in May, when our beloved kitten fell ill; the doctor immediately identified the problem, but unfortunately the disease was already in an advanced stage, the doctor treated her and tried to do everything possible to give the most dignified life possible to our little one, I can't find the right words to describe the person that Dr. Amalfitano is, empathetic, sensitive and everything that is still good in this world, I highly recommend his clinic, where love for animals is always put first, I publicly thank the doctor, Dr. Amalfitano and all his staff for what you have done for us and for our little one, thank you from the bottom of my heart ❤️

I brought our dog on January 2nd two years ago after I previously ran away from another clinic where they told us that our dog had mosquito bite disease and after a month they had eaten up tons of money! On January 2nd he had a hemorrhage and I will never forget it. I contacted them and the wonderful doctor who told us to bring him to us to see what the dog has. I found a caring staff and they immediately took care of our Power and after the ultrasound they told us no bites, the dog has malabsorption syndrome, an infection that has damaged the internal organs. This is the treatment to be done and the food our dog needed to recover... they gave us all the treatment including syringes that I went to them for every three days (where they didn't charge a single cent more)... now my dog ​​is safe and we only owe it to them... thanks to all of you! Attached you will find the photo of the dog before and after! Thank you

Dear Doctor,

I would like to express my deepest gratitude for the invaluable and constant assistance you provided me during the month of August, during a challenging time for UNO's health.

🫂

Thanks to your timely intervention, meticulous care, and the recommended therapy, he is doing significantly better today. Although some hair still needs to grow back in some areas, the improvement is evident and encouraging. We have successfully completed the entire treatment cycle, and all of this was possible thanks to your attentive guidance and great expertise.

I would especially like to thank you not only for the result achieved, but also for your undisputed expertise, which proved crucial even remotely, managing a complex situation like the one we encountered with clarity and effectiveness. It is rare to find a professional capable of combining clinical expertise, sensitivity, and availability as you did.

I am sincerely grateful for everything she has done, and I will always remember her professionalism with gratitude.

With respect and affection

Marco

One word: ANGELS.
Aron, 8 years old, pinscher. The love of my life. He had a terrible mouth infection caused by tartar buildup; it wasn't easy at all to treat that poor little animal. The love, expertise, care, and affection they show both clients and patients is indescribable and unparalleled. Their professionalism and empathy are impressive. I extend a special thanks to the entire clinic team, who, each in their own way, did an extraordinary job to prevent my little one from suffering further and to repair the damage. Please be wary of negative reviews; they are EXCELLENT, but above all, VERY HONEST when it comes to pricing! Thank you for everything. ♥️

I turned to this clinic, thanks to the reputation of its medical director, Dr. Amalfitano. I brought a Maltese dog from 5 months old, now 22 months old, and since mid-June, I've finally found someone who works as a doctor for passion, not for money. This clinic only offers emergency care, but they don't have the patience to get to the root of a problem. My dog ​​had a "fussy" appetite, and after several hospitalizations with a high-dose cortisone drip, they suggested a gastroscopy with biopsy. Please note, I have confirmation from the Veterinary Association that the gastroscopy was performed by a "technician," not by someone with a master's degree in gastroenterology. So, finally, in mid-June, when I went to Rome, I discovered that my dog ​​doesn't need a gastroscopy. First, a fecal swab should have been done to check the intestinal microbiota and a targeted treatment with hydrolyzed fibers to purify the liver (toxicated by cortisone). Then I forgot that here, vitamin B12 is in abundance. I did the tests with cyanoconalamine at 1000, and the maximum is 800. To conclude, I'm paying these people a €520 bill in installments. In Rome, for €370, I had a gastroenterologist visit with a written declaration that the dog doesn't need a gastroscopy, fecal swab for intestinal microbiota, and anything else. I won't go back because it's not even free for all the damage done. Thanks to everyone, including the Doctor! I solved it in Rome! My dog ​​is doing wonderfully!!!
The best veterinarians in Naples

My dog, Kira, underwent surgery. We were pleased with the care our little girl received, the empathy, professionalism, and above all, the humanity of Dr. Amalfitano, the doctor, and the anesthesiologist. The staff were very kind.
It's not easy to trust these days, but you didn't disappoint. Thank you.

We are Bella and Zeus, we've had different stories but one refuge when storms hit our young lives: the Salus Clinic. Raffaele, Claudia, and the entire staff have demonstrated that a job done with love, passion, and dedication can be truly successful! Thank you for the professionalism and humanity with which you saved us from a terrible fate. We love you (except when you give us syringes and when Claudia calls Zeus "Mutt").

We've known Dr. Raffaele and Dr. Claudia and their entire staff for only a few months, but I must say they've already won our hearts.
They demonstrated great professionalism and expertise in caring for our dog, who arrived at the clinic in terrible condition. The doctors explained the diagnosis clearly and were able to reassure us about the situation despite the difficulties. They're also always available, day and night.
We're happy to have met such wonderful doctors and can't recommend them highly enough.

Expert, serious, competent, humane, and professional doctor.
He solves everything in the blink of an eye!
It only took a few minutes to understand and resolve my little Kora's problem! I sincerely thank all the professionals at Clinica Salusvet!!! ❤️
Amalfi doctors are the best. I wouldn't know who to trust without them. They love their patients and are meticulous and empathetic.

What can I say about this wonderful doctor? Besides being a humane and sensitive person—because working with our furry friends requires these qualities—he's a caring and knowledgeable professional. It took him just two minutes to diagnose my dog ​​Teddy and get to the heart of the problem. I'm so happy to have met such a competent and kind person. I highly recommend him. Dr. Raffaele Amalfitano, a name you can trust.
I've been coming to SalusVet for a couple of years for my cat and I'm really happy with the service. Dr. Claudia Amalfinato is a competent professional and always available.

Dear Doctor,
For us, you embody everything the word Hero expresses.
Two years ago, we were looking for a doctor who could say something different than the other doctors: "He's a doomed dog," "He won't live long," "The operation is dangerous, he can't come out of this alive."
Our little dog suffered from Type A pulmonary stenosis and needed valvuloplasty, a significant surgical procedure for a small dog.
We searched far and wide for a doctor who could save his life.
We were told we'd have to travel north to find competent doctors, as the south lacked them.
After a long search, we knocked on the door of the SalusVet clinic in Vomero, where our Hero, Dr. Raffaele, and his family were waiting for us, who welcomed us with such sweetness and affection, so unexpectedly.
It was two years of constant visits, during which the doctor meticulously monitored our little dog's condition every month, keeping it under control to delay the operation as long as possible.
From the very first moment, we felt we were in safe hands, and our perceptions were right.
After almost two years, between visits, medications, anxiety, worry, and fear, our little dog collapsed.
It was all clear: the time for the operation had arrived!
On the day of the operation, the clinic was reserved entirely for our little dog and the family; there was no one else. It was long hours, a maddening wait, excruciating agony.
Until the doctor emerged from the operating room, he smiled: "Peppino made it."
From then on, a new era began. The post-operative journey was complicated, but it marked the beginning of a new life for the little dog: now he eats, runs, plays, and sleeps peacefully.

Doctor Raffaele, we could never thank you enough for everything you've done for us. You'll have our love for life.

"I'm a lucky little dog. My family saved my life, but you, Doctor, have given me a whole new one: this year I can even play at the beach ♥️"

We went during the week for my dog ​​who is now well. Very competent staff who love animals despite our many questions were very scrupulous and patient.
Competent staff, high professionalism, empathy, politeness and cleanliness.
